blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Today we learn the 12 months and dates.

Months and dates are part of every HR calendar. We use them for birthdays, reviews, and holidays. The year starts in January. We say "in + month" and "on + date".

For example: "The review is in April." "My birthday is on July 10." We go step by step. You can do it!

items.q: What do we learn today?
items.why: "Today we learn the 12 months and dates."

items.q: The text says months and dates are part of…
items.why: "Months and dates are part of every HR calendar."

items.q: Which word goes before a month?
items.why: "in + month" — ex.: "in April", "in December".

items.q: The text says "You can do it!". This suggests the tone is…
items.why: Inferência: "English comes in CAN's" e "You can do it!" mostram um tom positivo.

items.q: "My birthday is on July 10." The author would most likely say a date needs…
items.why: Inferência: com datas usamos "on" ("on July 10"), não "in".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o calendário do RH. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi team! I am Sophie from HR. Today I want to share our calendar for the year. It is very simple, so please listen.

First, the reviews. The next review is in April. Please put this date in your calendar. April is a busy month, so we start early. We talk about your goals and your work.

Next, the holidays. We have a holiday in December. The office is closed, and we can rest with our family. There is also a short break in June, so remember that too.

Now, the fun part — birthdays! We celebrate team birthdays every month. For example, my birthday is on July 10. Ana's birthday is on March 3. We bring a small cake and we sing together. It is a nice moment for the team.

One more thing. Our team training is on September 20. It is a Monday. Please save the date and come to the big room.

So, remember: reviews in April, holiday in December, and training on September 20. If you have a question about any date, just send me an email. Thank you, and have a great month!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: When is the next review?
items.why: "The next review is in April."

items.q: When is Sophie's birthday?
items.why: "my birthday is on July 10."

items.q: When is the team training?
items.why: "Our team training is on September 20."

items.q: Why does Sophie say December is special?
options: There is a holiday and the office is closed
The team starts a new project
items.why: Inferência: "We have a holiday in December. The office is closed, and we can rest."

items.q: How does Sophie feel about team birthdays?
options: She sees them as the fun part
items.why: Inferência: "Now, the fun part — birthdays!" e "we bring a small cake and we sing together".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The year starts in January." January is…
items.why: January = janeiro, o primeiro mês do ano.

items.q: "December is a busy month." A month is…
options: one of the 12 parts of the year
items.why: Month = mês; o ano tem 12 meses.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "What is the ___ today? It is May 5."
items.why: Date = data (ex.: May 5).

items.q: "Happy birthday! You are 30 today." A birthday is…
options: the day a person was born
items.why: Birthday = aniversário, o dia em que a pessoa nasceu.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The office is closed. It is a ___."
items.why: Holiday = feriado / férias; nesse dia o escritório fecha.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando falamos de calendário e datas. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's set up a meeting for April." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = marcar, organizar (uma reunião, um encontro).

items.q: "I will write down the date in my calendar." To write down means to…
options: put on paper or in a note
items.why: Write down = anotar, registrar por escrito.

items.q: "Sorry, I need a day off on July 10." A day off is…
options: a day you do not work
items.why: Day off = dia de folga, um dia sem trabalho.

items.q: "Can we put off the review to May?" To put off means to…
items.why: Put off = adiar, deixar para depois.

items.q: "I look forward to the December holiday." This means you…
options: are happy and waiting for it
items.why: Look forward to = estar animado, esperar algo com alegria.
